# Universal Node Graph — Flexible Solutioning

> A domain-neutral graph programming, compilation, search, and experimentation architecture.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Project overview and runnable examples
- [Normative specification](UNIVERSAL_NODE_GRAPH_SPEC.md): Required ontology and invariants
- [Research foundations](RESEARCH_FOUNDATIONS.md): Primary-source design rationale
- [LLM harness integration](LLM_HARNESS.md): Repository instruction and skill map
- [Full architecture blueprint](UNIVERSAL_GRAPH_SYSTEM.md): Extended design and viewer model
- [Workbench guide](WORKBENCH.md): Interactive hierarchical candidate explorer
- [Pipeline taxonomy](docs/PIPELINE_TAXONOMY.md): The 41 shapes engineering work
  comes in, classified by graph shape and silent failure mode, with counted
  coverage — read this first to find out whether a problem is a known shape

## Code

- [Universal core](solutiongraph/): Semantic model, compiler, search, evidence
- [Wire schemas](solutiongraph/schemas/): JSON Schema 2020-12 contracts
- [Browser adapter](browsergraph/): Concrete runtime proof
- [Universal conformance tests](tests/test_solutiongraph.py): Executable architecture requirements
- [Category map](browsergraph/taxonomy.py): Families, categories, and coverage
  counted from the template and pack registries
- [Due care](browsergraph/duecare.py): What an evaluation owes — obligations,
  PASS/PROVISIONAL/FAIL verdicts, and the regression feedback loop
- [Problem templates](browsergraph/templates.py): 39 shapes with typed ports,
  zero candidates, and the anti-patterns that travel with each
- [Domain packs](browsergraph/packs/): 12 shapes with the code written; every
  route of every pack is executed by a test
- [Workspace modeling skill](.agents/skills/model-solution-graph/SKILL.md): On-demand agent workflow
